a2a.permission: A new owner-issued grant must explicitly allow coordinate. Existing grants are unchanged.

privacy: No private records in discovery metadata. Credential holders cannot globally list projects or profiles.
billing: No payments, escrow, payouts, or economic commitments are implemented.

mcp.transport: stateless Streamable HTTP JSON responses; no SSE
mcp.authentication: Owner-issued task-scoped bearer credential; no OAuth discovery yet
mcp.mutation_retries: Supply a unique requestKey UUID per intended action; reuse for the same retry only

chatgpt.scope: Public connection guidance and Agent Card only. No private records or task execution.
chatgpt.private_access: The direct Supabase MCP endpoint uses a task credential. A native ChatGPT private-data connection needs a compatible owner-authorization flow; it is not enabled by repository access.
